metadata.title: Green Papaya and Beef Curry
metadata.description:
Papaya and Beef Curry or Modi phol aro Matchu as it is known in Garo is made of unripe green papaya cooked soft with beef. Unripe papaya acts as a meat tenderizer and also pairs really well with beef. Thin sliced onions, green chilies, mustard oil and ginger really tie this whole dish together. 

This dish is very simple to make and is very delicious.
